groups.problem: The trace-item attribute cache key omits organization identity, allowing results to be reused across organizations.
groups.rationale: All five suggestions identify the same query key and organization-specific request mismatch. Adding organization identity to that key resolves all five reports.

groups.problem: The feature-enabled dashboard table receives empty placeholders instead of actual query results and columns.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions report the same empty props in the TableWidgetVisualization branch and the resulting empty dashboard tables.

groups.problem: Truthiness checks fail to enforce age/timestamp mutual exclusion when both values are zero.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same validators and the same presence-versus-truthiness mistake. Their asymmetric-validation observations are consequences of that mistake.

groups.problem: Custom table renderer results incorrectly trigger fallback when they are falsy values other than undefined.
groups.rationale: Both report the same body-cell truthiness check and request the equivalent correction in the header renderer.

groups.problem: The Visualize migration leaves consumers reading the removed instance property yAxes instead of adapting to yAxis.
groups.rationale: S13 and S14 identify separate occurrences of the same incomplete property migration; S3 reports those same occurrences together. Each consumer needs its own update using the new property or serialization contract.

problems: Truthiness checks allow age and timestamp to coexist when both values are zero.
Making both fields optional allows reports containing neither age nor timestamp.
uncoveredProblems: Reports containing neither age nor timestamp are accepted because neither field is required.
